svg.text: VOC QUALITY - CURRENT ESP32-WROOM-32 MODULE WIRING
2026-11-02 | Firmware-aligned design | 38-pin DevKit + IO expansion documented; actual header geometry unverified
Harness pin numbers below are DESIGN assignments, except PMS5003 native pins. NOT fabrication-ready. Match module SIGNAL labels.
Fuse: size for wiring + measured load
02 MCU - GPIO names, NOT header position numbers
USB: avoid simultaneous external 5V unless power isolation is verified.
Do not join DevKit 3V3 output to the separate 3V3_SENS regulator.
TwoWire(1) is a second HARDWARE I2C controller, not software I2C.
3.3V UART/control levels; SET HIGH = operating. Verify connector orientation.
Firmware reports divided ADC-node mV; do not silently rescale calibration.
06 RELAY MODULE + TWO 5V DC FANS - provisional interface
Firmware currently writes HIGH to both relay inputs; active polarity is NOT verified.
Do not connect a module that pulls GPIO to 5V. Add a suitable interface after SKU check.
Contacts shown are logical relay-module terminals, not a bare relay coil pinout.
Fan current, contact rating, suppression and safe boot state require bench validation.
07 ANALOG MODULES - 7 x divider/filter channels; no 5V direct to ADC
MiCS-6814 analog module / onboard heater drive
Based on current voc_esp32.ino pin defines and repository wiring notes; not the proposed SHT40/SGP41/SPS30/ZE03 upgrade.
Divider gain = 0.6 nominal. At 5.25V and 1% resistor worst case: <=3.176V. Validate analog output limits, loading, noise and calibration.
All modules must be 3.3V-logic compatible. MQ/MiCS heaters and fans use 5V. Do not feed a bare MiCS heater from 5V.
Regulator dissipation = (5V - 3.3V) x sensor current: verify thermal budget. Size PSU/fuse/connectors from actual heater/fan start current.
Footprints, relay polarity/input interface, expansion-board jumpers and module SKUs remain unverified. No Gerber or production release.
